Every complementary child keeps its complete inherited marginal reference unchanged. The expected sum of all executed erasures plus all complete terminal cross entropies is at most c_cal+10e(a+b+r)<=(2C0+10)I(F), e=2^(1-a-b-r). No original quota is renewed, and every previous debit and complementary terminal is retained. Arbitrary no-reset continuation below a stopping leaf remains paid. An untouched independent terminal of prescribed cost c_h retains its exact additive c_h. Structural source R=P_g permits C0=4 and initial rate18. This is not arbitrary-source reference construction, arbitrary incoming-profile reset, or a universal FEI theorem.
